name: @playliquid/artifact-store
description: PlayLiquid content-addressed artifact store (PL-011, E7/E10). Deterministic SHA-256 blob digests, dedupe by digest, fail-closed integrity verification on fetch, stream-chunked write/read ports with in-memory fakes, byte-range reads and content-derived manifest records. Pure domain: no fs, no network — adapters own IO through the chunked blob ports.
